study.hypothesis: Observed first-layer results are nonmonotone: prefix96 AUC0.6669282617886453 exceeds prefix1080.666627507052977 despite fewer Parameters. The near-matched second480.6662416907813548 and its variance correction also failed to recover current-reference0.6671669182126774. Inherited random channel identity remains an alternative to a capacity requirement. A suffix or spread96-channel subnetwork may retain a more useful buy-to-context optimization path at the same width and scale. This is unverified and seed-specific; these replacements do not establish a unique gradient mechanism or seed-averaged capacity sufficiency.

study.proposed_difference: Four standalone cells: byte-identical current112/64 reference; prefix96 control; suffix96 and spread96 candidate replacements. Prefix indices0..95, suffix16..111, spread{i in0..111: i mod7 !=6}. Replace matching first-affine rows/biases, Dice alpha/running buffers and second-affine columns after every parent random draw, before optimizer construction. Removed channels retain no full storage. No forward gather/mask, additional RNG, data-dependent selection, trained pruning, new information, checkpoint, loss adjustment or runtime setting. This is an initialization/subnetwork attribution study; broader pruning priority is unverified and no novel method is claimed.
predictions: Full reference reproduces0049-reference AUC0.6671669182126774; prefix96 reproduces0049-first96 AUC0.6669282617886453 and historical all-task results. Same-seed bridges are execution checks, not independent repetitions.

All reduced cells have197075 dense/31793216 embedding/31990291 total Parameters versus204531/31793216/31997747. Removal7456=16*(400 incoming+1 bias+1 Dice alpha+64 outgoing), about3.65% dense but only0.0233% total. Host measurement must confirm.

A consequential fixed-capacity identity effect is a max-minus-min click AUC of at least0.0001 among the three masks; recovery to the frozen contemporary floor is the stronger utility criterion. Neither establishes statistical significance from one seed.

A useful reduction must also lower measured model-only p50 batch latency at least1%, with p95 and full-validation inference wall time no more than1% worse than the contemporaneous full reference. All task AUC/Logloss, train/wall time, throughput and peak memory remain reported.
falsifiers: Reference/prefix reproduction failure or numerical/masking/ownership failure invalidates interpretation pending diagnosis; retain execution costs and do not label it scientific counterevidence.
Both new masks losing more than0.0001 AUC versus the contemporaneous full reference reject their stronger current utility. Report original-entry preservation separately.
A spread below0.0001 AUC across all three reduced masks provides no support for the predeclared consequential identity effect in this bounded design.
Absent qualifying measured latency savings, parameter reduction alone fails utility. Repeated AUC loss or seed-specific rescue also prevents a robust preservation claim.
